title: Values as Architecture
subtitle: what holds when the weather changes
mapEpigraph: The structure decides what remains standing.

prompts.text: Which values define you at your best and help you make hard decisions?
What behaviors prove each value is structurally present?

blocks.title: Two values only
blocks.instruction: Choose two values only. For each, name one supporting behavior and one early warning sign that you are building outside it.

blocks.closing: Let the values make one decision today.
